As of October 2026, the best wireless earbuds depend on whether you care most about sound quality, noise cancellation, comfort, battery life, or value. The two strongest all-around contenders are the Sony WF-1000XM6 and Apple AirPods Pro 3, with the right choice largely depending on your phone and listening habits.
